cues.label: Hook
cues.text: Welcome to the Babulus preview. We are testing timing, cues, and playback. This is a longer segment so the storyboard has time to advance.

cues.label: Setup
cues.text: Each cue becomes a timed span in the script JSON. The player advances frame by frame. You should see the cue title change when we move past this point.

cues.label: Capability
cues.text: Next we highlight a capability. Imagine visuals changing here when we plug in real compositions.

cues.label: Outcome
cues.text: Playback should keep moving even without real video assets. This proves timing is correct.

cues.label: CTA
cues.text: Final cue. We can now iterate on rendering and swap in real visuals.
